scientific_integrity: Previously known: general q^(n-1)(q-1) lower bound, radius-one endpoint-difference construction and binary radius-two exception in Boutin–Goliber–Pelto. The new claim is q>=3, directed n=3, radius two, exact optimum and unique labeled optimizer; historical-priority uncertainty remains.
scientific_limitations: Only directed length three, radius two, finite alphabets q>=3, with q=2 as prior-known boundary. Larger critical lengths, undirected and Kautz graphs are outside scope. Empirical checks complement but do not replace the proof.
title: Unique radius-two identifying codes at length three in directed de Bruijn graphs
